speaker: lead
text: Oh, is everyone here? Is Emily not here yet?

speaker: member_b
text: Emily's still waiting for the elevator. They're doing construction downstairs, so only one is running.

speaker: member_c
text: Oh right, the line was huge this morning too. I took the stairs all the way up to the seventh floor.

speaker: lead
text: Seven floors? That's a real workout.

speaker: member_c
text: So I'm kind of hungry now. What are we having for lunch today?

speaker: member_b
text: Kimchi stew for me. It's been getting chilly lately, so I keep craving soup.

speaker: member_c
text: That kimchi stew place last time was way too salty. I want to try the new pho place next to it.

speaker: member_b
text: The line there was really long. We'd have to head out before twelve to get a seat.

speaker: member_c
text: Then let's leave at eleven fifty. I skipped breakfast today.

speaker: member_b
text: I have a phone call around then, so I might be a little late.

speaker: lead
text: How long is the construction going on? Getting by with one elevator is going to be rough for a while.

speaker: member_b
text: The building office notice says until the end of next month. They're redoing the whole lobby interior.

speaker: member_c
text: More than a month? Then I'll have to keep taking the stairs.

speaker: lead
text: Think of it as exercise. Maybe I'll start taking the stairs tomorrow too.

speaker: member_b
text: Aren't you on the twentieth floor? Twenty floors seems like a bit much.

speaker: lead
text: Yeah, good point. I'll have to think about that.

speaker: member_a
text: Sorry I'm late. The elevator just wouldn't come. I let three go by before I got on.

speaker: lead
text: No problem. Okay, let's get started. This is the workshop prep meeting, so let's settle the date first.

speaker: member_a
text: I'd like the third Friday of November.

speaker: member_b
text: The third Friday is the 21st, right? That works for me.

speaker: member_c
text: I don't have anything special that day either.

speaker: lead
text: Then let's just go with the 21st. Everyone okay?

speaker: member_a
text: Yes.

speaker: member_c
text: Yes, sounds good.

speaker: lead
text: Great, the date is set: Friday, November 21st.

speaker: member_c
text: Oh, the 21st is the week right after I get back from vacation.

speaker: member_b
text: Where are you going on vacation, Haeun?

speaker: member_c
text: I'm going to Europe on my own for the first time. Portugal and Spain. I set my vacation budget at two million won, and the flights alone are already 1.2 million.

speaker: member_b
text: Wow, flights are really expensive these days. Is it direct?

speaker: member_c
text: No, one layover. Direct flights were over 1.6 million.

speaker: member_a
text: What about places to stay? Isn't lodging even more expensive in Europe?

speaker: member_c
text: That's why I mostly booked hostels. I had no choice if I wanted to stay under two million. Working out the vacation budget was the hardest part.

speaker: lead
text: I hear Lisbon is great. I went a few years ago. You have to try the egg tarts.

speaker: member_c
text: I already saved a list of the best egg tart spots. There are over ten.

speaker: member_b
text: Are you going to Porto too? I heard the night view there is gorgeous.

speaker: member_c
text: Yes, two days in Porto. I booked a place by the river.

speaker: lead
text: Where in Spain? Barcelona?

speaker: member_c
text: Yes, three days in Barcelona, then over to Madrid, and I fly home from there. I want to see some museums.

speaker: member_b
text: Watch out for pickpockets. A friend of mine had a phone stolen twice in Barcelona.

speaker: member_c
text: I've heard that a lot, so I got one of those phone lanyards you wear around your neck.

speaker: member_a
text: Did you exchange money? I hear most places take cards these days.

speaker: member_c
text: Just a little. I'm planning to use a card for almost everything. I got a travel card.

speaker: member_b
text: Those are really convenient. I used one when I went to Japan last year.

speaker: member_a
text: I'm so jealous. I haven't used a single vacation day this year.

speaker: lead
text: Emily, make sure you use them before the end of the year. Otherwise they disappear.

speaker: member_a
text: Yes, I'm planning to take them all in December. But then it overlaps with year-end tax stuff, so I'm worried.

speaker: lead
text: Let's talk about that separately later. Okay, back to the workshop. Should we talk about what we'll do that day?

speaker: member_b
text: I'd rather we avoid things like hiking. Last year was really tough. My calves hurt so much the next day I couldn't even walk down the stairs.

speaker: member_c
text: I actually like doing something active outside. We sit at the office all day, every day.

speaker: member_a
text: Then how about something like a cooking class? We could all cook together and eat it for lunch.

speaker: member_b
text: Cooking is kind of... I'm really bad with a knife. At home I only make instant noodles.

speaker: member_c
text: How about board games? There are lots of team-building games these days.

speaker: member_a
text: With board games, I think all the time will go into explaining the rules.

speaker: member_c
text: Then what about an escape room? Splitting into teams of four could be fun.

speaker: member_b
text: An escape room is fine with me, as long as it's not a scary theme.

speaker: member_a
text: But with twelve people we'd have to split into three teams, and then we wouldn't get to talk to each other.

speaker: lead
text: Hmm, everyone wants something really different. And I think we should include something like a retrospective too.

speaker: member_a
text: Can't we just do the retro at the office? I'm not sure we need to talk about work even at the workshop.

speaker: member_b
text: I think so too. I'd like the workshop day to be a bit of a break.

speaker: member_c
text: But if we do nothing, it's just a day off. I feel like upper management will have something to say.

speaker: lead
text: Let's think about that some more. It's hard to decide right now.

speaker: member_c
text: Oh, by the way, you all know we have a joint meeting with another team next Thursday, right?

speaker: lead
text: Oh right, who was supposed to prepare the materials for that?

speaker: member_b
text: I was, originally, but their team asked us to change the format, so I'm redoing it.

speaker: lead
text: Why did they want the format changed?

speaker: member_b
text: Their director apparently prefers graphs over tables. So I'm redrawing everything as graphs.

speaker: member_c
text: That's going to take forever. Want me to help?

speaker: member_b
text: Thanks. Could you take just the last five slides?

speaker: member_c
text: Sure, send me the file. I'll look at it this afternoon.

speaker: lead
text: How much time do we get to present at the joint meeting?

speaker: member_b
text: Fifteen minutes. But there's no separate Q&A, so we have to take questions within the presentation.

speaker: lead
text: Then we need to cut down the slides. Try to keep it under ten.

speaker: member_b
text: It's eighteen slides now, but if I move some to the appendix, I think I can get it to ten.

speaker: member_c
text: So the five slides I'm helping with go to the appendix too?

speaker: member_b
text: Probably, yes. But the graphs still need to be redrawn. We need to show them if questions come up.

speaker: lead
text: Then show me a draft by Monday. I'll look it over and tell you what to cut.

speaker: member_a
text: Oh, but I heard there's a company-wide workshop in the third week of November? I think the admin team posted a notice.

speaker: lead
text: Really? Hold on, let me check my email.

speaker: lead
text: Oh, you're right. There's a company-wide workshop for two days, November 20th and 21st. Everyone has to attend.

speaker: member_b
text: Then it clashes exactly with our workshop date.

speaker: lead
text: It does. That day won't work. Let's put the date on hold for now and decide after we check the company schedule again.

speaker: member_a
text: Yes, that makes sense.

speaker: member_c
text: So we didn't actually decide anything today.

speaker: lead
text: Yeah. Oh, the director is looking for me, so I think I have to go first. They say it's urgent.

speaker: member_b
text: Okay, go ahead.

speaker: lead
text: Sorry. Let's get together again another time and continue this. I'll set up a new time.

speaker: member_c
text: Okay, got it.

speaker: member_a
text: Should we break up for now, then?

speaker: member_b
text: Yes. Haeun, if we go to that pho place now, maybe we won't have to wait in line?

speaker: member_c
text: Sure, let's go now. Emily, come with us.

speaker: member_a
text: Yes, I'll come too. Let's take the stairs instead of waiting for the elevator.

speaker: member_b
text: Oh, but could you wait just twenty minutes for me because of that phone call?

speaker: member_c
text: Then we'll go ahead and get in line. Message us when you get there.
